name: group and nulls
sql: SELECT k, COUNT(*), SUM(v) FROM (VALUES ('a',1),('a',NULL),('b',2)) t(k,v) GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

name: qualified join labels
sql: SELECT a.x,b.y FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(2)) a(x) JOIN (VALUES (2,'p'),(2,'q')) b(k,y) ON a.x=b.k ORDER BY a.x,b.y

name: parenthesized qualified label
sql: SELECT (a.x) FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) a(x) ORDER BY a.x

name: quoted qualified label
sql: SELECT a."MixedCase" FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) a("MixedCase") ORDER BY a."MixedCase"

name: explicit alias with qualified label
sql: SELECT a.x AS "Case Label",b.y FROM (VALUES (1)) a(x) JOIN (VALUES (2,'p')) b(k,y) ON a.x < b.k

name: window peers
sql: SELECT x, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES (2),(1),(2)) t(x) ORDER BY x

name: decimal multiplication
sql: SELECT CAST(1.20 AS DECIMAL(5,2))*CAST(2.50 AS DECIMAL(5,2))

name: semi join
sql: SELECT x FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) a(x) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES (2),(3)) b(y) WHERE b.y=a.x) ORDER BY x

name: except
sql: SELECT x FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(2)) a(x) EXCEPT SELECT y FROM (VALUES (1)) b(y)

name: missing column
sql: SELECT absent FROM (SELECT 7 AS present) s
